title: MIDI Stage
author: Seth Morrow
description: Realtime MIDI, through the midixt extension. A player and a stage in one window: the player plays five short scenes (an arpeggio, chords, eight knobs, a pitch bend, drums and program changes), each one a real MIDI message, and the stage draws only what arrives: a piano roll, a keyboard, the knobs, the wheels and a light for each channel. Here the browser keeps MIDI from a shared stack, so the stage reads each message as the player makes it, and says so. On a desktop with midixt, a keyboard of your own lights up beside the player, and Sound plays the player through a synth.
